anatomy: T-Rex: two hind legs, two front arms SHORTER than his head; pterodactyl two legs two wings
motion_rule: the T-Rex drives his whole bulk across frame in EVERY window, speech included, never from behind the counter; the granny stays in frame from 1.35 and takes it from 7.25; the meat moves in every window
camera_moves: low angle, ONE take, no cuts, camera always moving, shot size changing every window
character: grumpy old T-Rex butcher, enormous head, tiny arms, stained apron, rolled sleeves, one white daisy behind his ear; the buyer is an old granny pterodactyl housewife in a headscarf with a string bag
props: a long wooden counter; a mound of meat shoved along it; one wooden sign, drawings only: two radishes crossed out, a chicken beside them; one cleaver; her string bag
environment: clear noon, market row, wooden stalls, grass
lighting: blazing noon sun, bright throughout, hard shadows

audio.delivery: T-Rex a gravelly old male barker; granny a creaky indignant old female; both 4.6 syllables per second, never hurried
audio.pronunciation: natural native Russian stress, no accent
audio.pacing: one unbroken phrase per window, no pause inside a phrase spanning two windows, silence in wordless beats; he stops at 7.25, she answers from 7.6
audio.lip_sync: jaw works each syllable, mouth free of props, voice always from the mouth that moves
audio.sfx: boards rumbling 0.0;counter bang 1.35;sign thump 2.2;cleaver 4.45;slab scraping 5.1;wing beats 7.25;snatch 8.85

timeline.a: he charges the row shouldering the mound along the boards, camera racing him low
he hurls the mound round to the lens, bulk turning after it, camera arcing his snout
he rams the counter with his hip, the granny swinging into frame at his elbow
he stamps the sign into the mound, hauling his weight over it, camera pushing the drawings
he swings his bulk back down the row, camera travelling with him
he rams the crossed-out radishes, driving the sign along the boards, the granny scuttling under him
he wheels round to the lens, tail sweeping the stalls, the mound sliding after him
he slams the cleaver into the boards by the drawn chicken, the granny huge at the lens
he throws his bulk down the row as she rips the slab off the counter into her bag
he shoulders the mound down the counter after her
he drives into the lens, snout filling the frame over her headscarf
he swings away down the row, tail lashing the mound along the boards
she heaves the bag against the sun, wings beating, he barging under it, arms falling short
she hauls the bag along the boards into the lens, headscarf huge, he lunging after her
the daisy drops on the meat, she snatches meat and flower away down the row, he crashing after

must_appear: arms shorter than his head; apron, daisy behind his ear; meat moving along the counter; the granny in a headscarf with her bag; sign: crossed-out radishes and a chicken
negative_prompt: cyrillic, letters, digits, subtitles, watermark, night, dark scene, hard cut, human hands, second dinosaur, slow motion, slow speech, static camera, T-Rex standing still, reaching without moving his feet, T-Rex working from behind the counter, T-Rex absent from frame, floating props, pterodactyl small in the background, two mouths moving at once, male voice on her line, accented Russian
